answer: Each eligible identity commits a task seed before a specified future drand round; after the threshold-BLS pulse is published, the verifier derives the challenge as a domain-separated hash of the round, seed, and labels saffron, relic, and ferrous. The pulse is unpredictable under the beacon’s threshold assumptions, so a swarm cannot precompute valid responses offline; stake or another scarce admission cost is still needed to limit identities.
